chunks: Hisham ibn al-Hakam narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever resides in Mecca for one year, tawaf is better for him than salat (prayer). Whoever resides for two years, he should combine between this and that. And whoever resides for three years, salat (prayer) becomes better for him.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous or superior in merit
key_terms.الطَّوَافُ: circumambulation around the Ka'bah as an act of worship
key_terms.بِمَكَّةَ: in Mecca, the sacred city where the ruling applies

ai.seo_question: For a person living in Mecca, is tawaf better than salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states a ruling about the relative merit of tawaf and salat (prayer) for one residing in Mecca over different lengths of time. It indicates that tawaf is more excellent in the first year, both are to be combined in the second, and salat (prayer) becomes more excellent by the third year.
